description: This file contains an automated end-to-end test case for verifying the API key configuration flow in a web application using Playwright testing framework. It includes steps to clear storage, input an API key, and verify navigation to the main dashboard.

methods.name: test.describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for the API key configuration positive flow.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines an individual test case that performs the validation steps.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Provides assertion methods to verify UI elements and state.

methods.name: page.addInitScript
methods.description: Adds a script to be executed before any other scripts on the page, used here to clear local and session storage.

methods.name: page.goto
methods.description: Navigates the page to the specified URL ('/'), waiting until the DOM content is loaded.

methods.name: page.getByRole
methods.description: Retrieves elements based on ARIA roles, with optional name or placeholder filters.

methods.name: page.getByPlaceholder
methods.description: Finds input elements based on their placeholder text.

methods.name: page.evaluate
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code within the page context, used here to access localStorage.
